narrative: A team member can now act as their own admin — running `gw self-serve new-repo`, `update-content`, `add-member`, or `add-exception` without a platform engineer. A YAML policy file governs every request by team identity, naming pattern, and allowed setting type, failing closed on absent lists. The plan engine tracks self-serve repos, exceptions, and memberships through all three state branches (create / unchanged / delete), closing the I2 regression. Acceptance tests now fail fast on missing credentials instead of skipping silently, and containment and reset are proven against live API state, not CLI output.
